audience: online sellers who sell through marketplaces and webshops with EffectConnect

useCases.title: Check which channels are linked
useCases.text: List the channels linked to your API key. Read one channel by its identifier to use it in other tools.

useCases.title: Find orders by status or date
useCases.text: Search orders by order date, last update, status, tag or channel. Read the full details of the orders you need.

useCases.title: Look up a product by SKU or EAN
useCases.text: Find a product by its SKU, EAN or other identifier. Search by product selection to list the products a channel can sell.

useCases.title: Check a background catalog or order report
useCases.text: List the asynchronous processes and read the status of one. Read its report after the process finishes.
